Coverage includes line layers, layer blur, edge blur, corner radius, edit shortcuts, Image Lab range re-editing with Drag mode removal, text kerning, layer grouping, fit-to-canvas, editable palette colors, palette groups, palette opacity, harmony suggestions, CSV/HTML persistence, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing README guidance, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and browser storage quota edge cases remain future work.
